summary: Split the monolithic frontend vendor bundle in apps/app into logical Rolldown chunks (markdown, ui-vendor, schema, vendor), shrinking the main JS chunk from 898 kB to 260 kB and clearing the 500 kB warning. Verified via svelte-check, vitest (170 tests), and a clean production build, then committed as 566a1f0. Separately confirmed that @earendil-works/pi-coding-agent is declared as ^0.84.2 in two package.json files but pnpm-lock.yaml pins and patches 0.84.2; the latest published version on npm is 0.84.4.
decisions: Split the apps/app frontend bundle via Rolldown output.codeSplitting groups: a 'markdown' group for dompurify/highlight.js/marked (priority 30), a 'ui-vendor' group for @floating-ui, @lucide/svelte, @tanstack, bits-ui, tabbable (priority 20), a 'schema' group for typebox (priority 10), and a catch-all 'vendor' group for remaining node_modules.

Do not change the @earendil-works/pi-coding-agent dependency range in this segment; keep ^0.84.2 in apps/agent-server/package.json and packages/extensions/package.json, leaving the lockfile at the patched 0.84.2.
